# Machine Learning and Data Science

Fixture Corp develops predictive models for demand forecasting, churn prediction and anomaly detection.
The data science team works with Python, scikit-learn and PyTorch, and can deploy models behind REST APIs.

## Data preparation

Projects include data cleaning, feature engineering and model evaluation reports so that stakeholders can
understand how well a model performs before it goes live.
